Good morning. I was wondering if my Hammer Thor p2 ships out today?
Thankyou B.

Good morning Bill,

Your order Shop···· is paid and still with our Canadian warehouse in Brampton. October 29 is the ship date on your order, and the Thor P2 stock for it has not been checked in there yet, so I can't tell you a label goes on the box today. Nothing else is holding it up, and the moment the label is made the tracking email comes to you automatically.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Note to the team: Happy to help, Bill. Nothing else is needed from you. As soon as the Thor P2 lands at Brampton and the label goes on your box, the tracking email comes straight to you, along with the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA on the same order. If anything comes up once it is running,…
